fatal_blockers: Pro's review does not rebut the asymptotic clause-drop attack. On minimally unsatisfiable growing formulas, deleting a low-canonical-indegree clause and zeroing its incident bags gives cost B+O(m) while B=Theta(m^2), so the approximation ratio tends to 1.
A B+64 audit of the same nine-clause instance cannot address this asymptotic failure. The candidate supplies no weighting, composition, hierarchy, or lower bound producing a gap proportional to B.

The claimed exhaustive shell certificate is not independently executable end to end. Zero-residual cases rely partly on structural reasoning, and the one-residual exclusion uses asserted case labels rather than enumerated certificates.
The statement that the G11 collision lifts only at total 1448 is unproved because only one canonical extension was evaluated. Alternative pair-bag extensions were not optimized or excluded.
evidence: The successful verifier supports only the fixed B=520 instance through B+32: it establishes the control minimum and a finite shell exclusion, not asymptotic soundness.
The asymptotic attack has stated objective B+25[2m-2+d_i(m-3)]; with d_i at most 1 this is B+O(m), whereas complete pair-bag anchoring makes B quadratic.
SOL_RESULT and the project notes explicitly classify the result as finite and deny any composition or dimension-dependent gap theorem.

The observed G11 lift at B+928 and the control-derived drop audits are witness evaluations on one hardcoded instance, not lower bounds for growing formula families.
